what: The hand-edited half of the CFB live calibration: which candidate is in shadow, the rule it must pass on unseen games, and the switch a person flips to promote it. The fitted half is football/cfb_p4/live_calibration.js, GENERATED by football/cfb_p4/research/live_calibration.js. Report: docs/cfb-calibration/README.md.
candidate_basis: The structural fault the audit found: ratings are learned against a 3.2-point home field (params.rating.hyperparams.hfa) while every projection adds the 4.082-point league constant measured on 2001-2013 (params.venue.league_hfa). HFA_PRE is the correction fitted on 2015-2025 final margins only (football/cfb_p4/margin_calibration.js, cfb_margin_cal_v1: slope 0.9637, home field 2.582). It never saw a 2026 game and never saw a market number, so every 2026 game it is scored on is genuinely unseen.
promote_basis: A person flips this to true. The generated file is promoted only when this is true AND the candidate's walk-forward record passes promotion_rule; either alone changes nothing.

walk_forward.population: FBS vs FBS. Every 2026 parameter is fitted on FBS-vs-FBS games only and applied to them only: FBS-vs-FCS games price every FCS opponent at one floor rating, behave as a different population (actual vs model slope 1.23) and drag a pooled fit the wrong way. They keep the published number in every option.
walk_forward.initial_training: weeks 2-3 are never scored; they are the initial training period
walk_forward.market_rule: the latest pregame spread EdgeDesk OBSERVED at or before the pick's own publication time (record quote ledger, lab quote ledger, the record's entry market and the pick's price lock, whichever was observed last but not after the pick). Never the close.

promotion_rule.basis: VALIDATED needs every condition: enough unseen games and weeks; a paired-bootstrap 95% interval on the Brier change entirely below zero; log loss better; margin MAE no more than 0.05 worse; better Brier in at least two thirds of the scored weeks; no conference group, margin bucket or favourite side with 30+ games worse by more than 0.005 Brier; and a probability that is a function of the margin (isotonic is not). CANDIDATE: Brier and log loss both better but the rest not yet shown. REJECTED: Brier and log loss both worse. RESEARCH_ONLY: anything else.

guardrail.basis: A hard cap is a last guardrail, not a fix. Tested at 0.95 it changed Brier by 0.0000 and made log loss worse by 0.0012 on the scored games, so it is off. When set, the engine applies it by widening sigma so the margin, the distribution and the probability still agree.

blend.basis: The market blend is fitted and reported every run (w, and whether w should fall with disagreement or with margin size) but never applied: its fitted model weight is about 0.1, i.e. it publishes the sportsbook line, and the slate this number is published on carries no publish-time line. Enabling it needs the slate builder to join the line observed at publication first.
